independence_evidence: Self-published title: magCulture's listing names Gemma Peckham as 'editor and publisher', the publisher's FAQ says it is located in New York City and the site carries no parent company; it also runs its own wholesale programme.
qualifies_reason: Independent New York quarterly about reading with Issue 025 out in October 2026 and a continuous run of issues through 2025.
what_it_is: A quarterly magazine about the experience of reading rather than book reviews: personal essays, reader interviews, humour and illustrated features about why and how people read, with illustrated covers. Each issue runs about 70 pages and is sold by subscription, in bookshops and as a digital edition. It is for people who read a lot and want a magazine about that habit itself.
